digest.component_or_area: git contention seam / store write interface
propositions: The test has two concurrent writers that each call add and commit as separate run_git_write invocations against a shared git index, allowing an interleaving where alpha's commit sweeps up beta's staged changes and beta's commit becomes a no-op with rc=1 and empty stderr.
Worker assertions report only r.stderr and omit both the git stdout (which contains the diagnostic message) and the name of the failing inner command, making failures self-diagnosing impossible.
Each writer must commit its own pathspec rather than the whole index so that a writer losing the add/commit interleaving still has its own change to commit and does not observe 'nothing to commit'.
The test must still require that both concurrent writers exit 0 through run_git_write and both commits are present in git log after the fix.
